verses.1: In old age, do not overstep the limits; instead, treat them as fathers, and as brothers in their younger years.
verses.2: The grandmother as a mother, the young woman as a sister in every sense of the word.
verses.3: She is truly a poor person.
verses.4: But if someone has children or descendants, they must first teach them to be pious and to give offerings to their ancestors. This is what is required of them before God.
verses.5: But those who were truly poor and isolated, they hoped in God and offered their prayers and supplications night and day.
verses.6: And she died while living a life of wastefulness.
verses.7: And he said all these things, so that they might not be deceived.
verses.8: But if anyone refuses to accept this, especially those who have private property and homes, then they deny the truth and are considered unbelievers.
verses.9: I should be considered old enough to have sixty years of experience. One man and one woman.
verses.10: In good deeds, he was known as a witness; whether he gave shelter to those in need, or helped those who were distressed, or walked with the feet of the saints. He always supported all good deeds.
verses.11: But the old woman will be released from her suffering. For when Christ is destroyed, they will want to get married again.
verses.12: You deserve punishment for having rejected the first belief.
verses.13: And they also learn slowly. They step out of their homes, not only slowly, but also in a hesitant and awkward manner. They speak about things that aren’t appropriate to say.
verses.14: I therefore want to be able to marry young, have children, and become a husband. I don’t want to give any reason for anyone to slander me in this regard.
verses.15: Some have already turned back from Satan’s side.
verses.16: If anyone has widows in their household, it is sufficient for them to provide for those widows. The church should not be burdened by having to support those who are truly widows.
verses.17: Those who were well-prepared and worthy of double respect should be honored. Especially those who were skilled in speech and teaching.
verses.18: For the text says: “Now, when you’re working, you shouldn’t be paid less than what’s due. The worker deserves to be paid according to his work.”
verses.19: According to the second charge, he refuses to admit guilt. This is because there are not two or three witnesses who can testify against him.
verses.20: He corrected those who were sinning in front of everyone, so that the rest might also feel fear.
verses.21: I accuse these things before God and Jesus Christ, as well as before the chosen angels. I ask that you keep these things safe, without doing anything against their teachings.
verses.22: Do not hastily commit any sins or evil deeds. Keep yourself pure and holy.
verses.23: I no longer use water, but rather a little wine, due to the dryness of my mouth and the weakness of my throat.
verses.24: For some people, sins become signs of their faults; they lead them towards judgment. But for others, they continue to be a source of trouble.
verses.25: In the same way, even those good and desirable tasks cannot be hidden from others.
